content: ROLE HIGHLIGHTS: - Job Title: Security Officer - Department: ICEYE Security Spain - Location: Valencia, Spain - Reports to: CEO, ICEYE Spain - Employment type: Permanent - Working type: On-Site - Employment is subject to applicable security screening and clearances WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS: In this position you will build and own the classified information security posture that lets ICEYE Spain operate within the required classification, coordinating the efforts to achieve and maintain “Reservado Nacional” security clearance, and its NATO and EU equivalents. You are the person who will build the defensible, audit-ready security framework for ICEYE Spain. You will design it, run it, and represent it to the appropriate authority. You are also the trusted advisor that will support the Spain CEO as the first point of contact for Security matters. This is a role for a builder; someone that is confident in defining, maintaining and communicating the security framework that enables ICEYE’s continued growth and meeting our obligations to our customers. WHO WE ARE ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth. ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system. ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future. Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. With continuous learning opportunities, cutting-edge projects, and collaboration with industry-leading experts, you'll have the chance to grow, innovate, and shape the future of Earth Observation. WHAT WILL YOU DO IN THIS ROLE? ICEYE is seeking a Mechanical AIT (Assembly, Integration & Testing) Engineer to own the mechanical side of production end to end -- integration, testing, supplier selection, continuous improvement, and adapting processes as new designs come through. In this role, you will be the technical expert responsible for satellite mechanical integration and vibration testing, ensuring that the structure, payload, solar arrays, propulsion and thermal hardware come together as a flight-ready unit that survives launch. You will act as the primary technical contact for mechanical integration issues and drive improvements in build cycle time, test efficiency and build reliability, ensuring every spacecraft meets ICEYE’s high standards for reliability and mission success. Key Responsibilities - Lead the mechanical integration of the satellite (structure, payload, solar arrays, propulsion, harness routing, thermal hardware), including torque control, bonding, alignment and mass properties measurements - Own vibration test campaigns end to end: test specification, fixtures, instrumentation, execution, data analysis and reporting, with test levels and FEM correlation defined together with Structures Engineering - Act as primary technical contact for mechanical integration issues, performing root cause analysis on nonconformances and coordinating with Mechanical/Structures Engineering to resolve anomalies - Survey, evaluate and select suppliers and test facilities for mechanical parts, MGSE and fixtures, including audits and first article inspections - Contribute to and improve AIT documentation, including mechanical integration procedures, test plans and as-built configuration records - Interface with Global AIT, Mechanical/Structures Engineering, QA and Launch teams to ensure alignment on product standards and lessons learned - Drive continuous improvement and automation in mechanical integration methods, test data processing and build cy

Your day-to-day responsibilities - Report to the ANZ Data Sales team - Build and maintain a trusted network of Intelligence and GEOINT practitioners across ANZ defence, intelligence and other industries: attending user engagements, demonstrations, and briefings to represent ICEYE credibly at the working level and stay close to user needs, priorities, and procurement timelines. - Advise internal ICEYE teams (Missions, Data and Solutions) on how ANZ military and intelligence users consume intelligence imagery, what tradecraft matters, and how to frame ICEYE’s products in language that resonates with analysts and collection managers. - Identify key decision-influencers across ANZ target organisations, and plan, host, and lead ICEYE engagements, from technical demonstrations to senior roundtables, to build trust and advance ICEYE’s standing. - Participate as needed in ANZ military exercises that incorporate ICEYE capability, representing ICEYE at the operational level and capturing lessons that feed back into product and service development. - Maintain strong CRM discipline and provide clear market intelligence to support business planning and decision-making. - Produce responses to RFPs, proposals, inbound enquiries, assist with promotional material and attend relevant industry events. What we’re looking for Must haves: - An established personal network within the ANZ geospatial community at the working and mid-senior level (people who will take your call) - 5+ years of strategic sales or enterprise business development experience in the aerospace, defence, space, ISR, earth observation, or related government technology sector. - Proven experience selling to ANZ government, defence, or public sector organisations, with an existing network you can activate from day one - Strong understanding of earth observation, ISR, or satellite-based capabilities, ideally including SAR. - Proven ability to run complex sales cycles, including lead qualification, opportunity development, capture planning, stakeholder mapping, and deal closure. - Willingness to travel as required, primarily across the ANZ region and to Europe. YOUR DAY-TO-DAY RESPONSIBILITIES - Lead and contribute to trade studies, design reviews (PDR/CDR), and verification and production qualification documentation (PRR/ERR). - Ensure smooth, seamless and on time product delivery, from concept to qualification. - Contribute to the continuous improvements of our current products. - Collaborate with suppliers, supply chain, AIT engineering and QA department to ensure our products are compliant with launch and on-orbit environments. - Collaborate with system and subsystem engineers to define requirements for new products. - Collaborate with both internal and external engineering teams and AIT teams during product integration and build to validate the engineered solutions are meeting the set requirements and targets. Support issue resolution if and where necessary. - When needed, engage in broader spacecraft mechanical design tasks, providing cross-disciplinary support. WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR Must haves: - Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or related field - Experience in aerospace, automotive, or related industries - Experience in designing satellites structures, subsystems or similar complex electromechanical systems - Understanding of mechanical stress, vibration, and thermal effects on space structures & mechanisms - Ability to work cross-functionally with systems, electrical, and manufacturing teams - Familiarity with industry standards such as ECSS, NASA, MIL - Strong team working, analytical, documentation, and communication skills - Ability to make multi team and organisational impact Nice to haves: - Experience with PLM/PDM systems for configuration control - Hands-on experience with mechanical systems assembly, integration, and testing - Prior experience with launch vehicle or spacecraft environments (SpaceX, Rocket Lab, ESA, etc.) APPLICATION PROCESS - Talent Attraction Introduction - Hiring Manager Alignment - Task Assignment - Technical Interview - Director Interview WORKING AT ICEYE At ICEYE, you’ll join a diverse and highly engaged team united by the ambition to make the impossible possible.
